Q: Dreamer integration for custom environment A:

Your custom MuJoCo env with 5 connected movers likely needs better observation normalization, denser rewards, and explicit collision/wire constraints in the latent dynamics for Dreamer to succeed. World models struggle with highly constrained multi-body continuous control unless the env exposes rich, Markovian states and the RSSM is tuned for long horizons. Test with simplified versions first; Dreamer isn’t inherently unsuitable but requires careful adaptation beyond standard Gym wrappers. Check TorchRL Dreamer examples for observation preprocessing and model architecture tweaks.

Q: Sql server convert datetime to ''YYYY-MM-DD'T'HH:mm:ss.SSS'Z" A:

As of now I can see only one way to get the desired answer:

Select CONVERT(varchar(20),start_date,126)+ substring(CONVERT(varchar(35),start_date,121),20,23)+'Z' AS required_date from Table1

Please comment if any optimized way.

Q: Access-Control-Allow-Origin Multiple Origin IP A:

try add instead of append and should not contain ":"

Header add Access-Control-Allow-Origin "http://10.17.52.50:18080"

https://www.w3.org/wiki/CORS_Enabled

But you can only add only one rule

if you have multiple ips or domains then you must use regex as follows

SetEnvIf Origin "^https?://(www\.)?yourdomain\.com(:9000)?$|https?://youripadress" your_var=$0
Header always set Access-Control-Allow-Origin %{your_var}e env=your_var
Header always set Access-Control-Allow-Credentials "true" env=your_var
Header always set Access-Control-Allow-Methods "POST, GET"

Q: PyInstaller exe file doesn't create log file A:

I have the same problem. The following scheme is feasible.

if hasattr(sys, "_MEIPASS"):                   
  print("base dir = ", sys._MEIPASS)
  CURRENTDIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[0]))
else:
  CURRENTDIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

print('cur dir = ', CURRENTDIR)

Q: Specify arrangement of Mermaid subgraphs A:

If you add a sequence of three hidden nodes, then link one subgraph to each of them, you can force the order. It's a bit weird to have to link them in reverse order, but it works:

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid/dist/mermaid.min.js"></script>

<div class="mermaid">
flowchart LR

subgraph A
    A1
    A2
    A3
end

subgraph B
    B1
    B2
end

subgraph C
    C1
end

A1 --> B1 --> A2
B1 --> C1 --> B2
C1 --> A3

X:::hidden ~~~ Y:::hidden ~~~ Z:::hidden
Z ~~~ A
Y ~~~ B
X ~~~ C

classDef hidden display:none;
</div>

Q: Convert string to native date object A:

Use this :

PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d-',column_name) AS native_date

Use SAFE.PARSE_DATE() when the source data may contain invalid dates to avoid runtime errors.
